scope: Read-only independent review of uncommitted CI input bundle transport, shared Python pin, and no-deploy marker. This is not final CI or game acceptance.

resource_model.prepare_peak_components: existing base checkout + Git objects + restored payload 4434365875 + tar approx4438273536 + proof/toolchain overhead
resource_model.consumer_peak_components: base checkout/Git/toolchain + tar approx4438273536 + staging payload4434365875; publishing uses hardlinks, not another full payload copy. Tar removed after success before tests.
resource_model.network: prepare uploads approx4.44GB; two physical lanes and affected each download approx4.44GB, approx13.31GB total downloads. Git historical object fetches replaced, not all bytes eliminated.
unmeasured: actual Git compressed/delta pack bytes on GitHub runner
full bundle upload/download time and service throughput
actual full-scale hash CPU/wall time and peak disk
resource_model.recommendation: Before final run, minimally log disk_usage/df at prepare export and consumer restore plus required payload/tar bytes and observed phase wall timings; fail clearly if space insufficient. Do not drop inputs, shrink 178 checks, or assume a standard runner has enough space. Actual final CI is mandatory.

limitations: No local full4.43GB archive constructed due local free-space constraint.
No Godot or full CI run triggered or cancelled by reviewer.
Review catches deterministic symlink and no-overwrite races; does not claim to harden all filesystem parent TOCTOU attacks against a hostile concurrently mutating local process.
Raw original old CI failure remains unchanged; successor results cannot sign it passed.
reviewer_actions_note: One read-only git ls-tree -l command unintentionally requested promisor object metadata and started Git lazy fetch; reviewer detected and terminated the isolated metadata subprocess chain. No source/index/ref changed. All later Git inspections used --no-lazy-fetch.
